recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future replacement of the DIMDI URL with a BfArM URL should be handled as a new THO or German-affiliate terminology update, not by reintroducing ICD-X variant details into FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-13723 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 Vocabulary issue asking to replace the old ICD-10-GM canonical http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-de with http://fhir.de/CodeSystem/dimdi/icd-10-gm and note that URL on the ICD-X page.
initial_application: Git commit 0e62a58596def5e5ad04ada1f88f7cd701867ee4, matching Jira comment svn 14619, changed the old source/icd.html Germany row to list http://fhir.de/CodeSystem/dimdi/icd-10-gm. Earlier history had already removed the obsolete http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-de row.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 and UP-289 later moved Using External Code System pages, including ICD-X guidance, from FHIR core to THO; commit 81e5862f20 deleted source/icd.html and source/terminologies-systems.html now links to the THO ICD page. FHIR-41305 later adjusted the generic ICD row in the current core page. The current THO 7.1.0 English ICD page still lists Germany with http://fhir.de/CodeSystem/dimdi/icd-10-gm and uses that URL in examples. A 2025 German Zulip thread informally says http://fhir.de/CodeSystem/bfarm/icd-10-gm is now preferred, but that is not a FHIR-core Jira decision and belongs to THO/German-affiliate terminology governance if pursued.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current core source is correct for this issue because it no longer owns the detailed ICD-X variant page and links readers to THO, where the requested content is present.
